data.name: Aabira
data.gender_notes: Aabira is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābira (عابرة), the feminine active participle of ʿabara 'to cross, to pass through', from the root ʿ-b-r. Feminine counterpart of ʿĀbir. Aabira therefore means “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿābira 'she who crosses'; used as a given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabira expresses “Gentle Wind”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabira total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

faq.q: Is Aabira the feminine of Aabir?
faq.a: Yes. Aabira (عابرة) is the feminine active participle of the same Arabic root ʿ-b-r, meaning 'she who crosses, female passer-by', the counterpart of the male name Aabir.

faq.q: What does the name Aabira mean?
faq.a: Aabira means “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabira come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabira?
faq.a: The root of Aabira is ع-ب-ر (ʿ-b-r).

faq.q: How is Aabira written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabira is written عابرة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabira a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabira is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabira appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabira is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabira verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿābira 'she who crosses'; used as a given name..
